facts.raw_span: 4 days of blurry vision and pain in her left eye
after undergoing a routine dental cleaning 1 week prior
no history of gingival disease or cavities
Visual acuity was 20/25 OD and 20/50 OS
Intraocular pressures were 15 mm Hg OD and 11 mm Hg OS
conjunctival hyperemia, faint keratic precipitates, 3+ cells with fibrin in the anterior chamber
mild nuclear sclerosis, and a whitish focal granuloma at the 4-o'clock position at the pupillary margin
no evidence of vitritis, retinitis, or vasculitis
visual acuity declined to 20/100 OS, with development of hypopyon and increased fibrinous material emanating from the iris lesion
Gram stain revealed gram-positive cocci in chains and gram-positive rods in a branching pattern
Aerobic culture revealed Streptococcus intermedius
Blood and urine cultures, electrocardiogram and echocardiogram were unremarkable
